summary: Tested public homepage, desktop interactions, mobile navigation, and core API behavior. Most flows pass; two issues remain: external-host validation returns 503 instead of 400, and mobile decorative elements expand document width.

critical.issue: https://notinstagram.com/brand is accepted because validation uses a substring check for instagram.com; the request reaches scraping and returns 503 for missing APIFY_TOKEN instead of rejecting the malformed host with 400.

issues: document scrollWidth is 550px versus a 390px viewport; .ambient-one and rotated .orbit-a/.orbit-b extend beyond the viewport. The shell visually clips them, but the page still has horizontal overflow metrics.

action_items: Validate Instagram URLs by parsing the hostname and requiring instagram.com or www.instagram.com, not substring matching.
Constrain or hide decorative ambient/orbit elements on mobile so document scrollWidth equals the viewport width.
critical_code_review_comments: normalize_profile_url currently trusts any URL containing instagram.com, allowing attacker-controlled lookalike hosts to be sent to the Apify actor.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. The initial dashboard is a MOCKED static sample profile until live analysis succeeds.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop homepage, anchors, quick demo handles, empty validation, actionable missing-APIFY error, sample dashboard, JSON/CSV downloads, CRM toast, schema tabs, and mobile menu opening were exercised. Re-run the API regression and mobile overflow check after fixes.
rca of the issue: Backend RCA: normalize_profile_url checks whether the raw URL contains the text instagram.com rather than parsing and validating its hostname, so notinstagram.com passes and then fails later in scraping. Frontend RCA: large absolutely positioned ambient/orbit decorations retain desktop dimensions at mobile widths; overflow:hidden on .app-shell visually clips them but document scrollWidth remains wider than the viewport.
